project_type: Vite + React 19 + TypeScript SPA with Convex serverless backend, Capacitor mobile wrapping
build_system: pnpm + vite + tsc (TypeScript 6.x). Convex types are pre-generated in convex/_generated/
test_framework: No test framework configured. Validation via TypeScript type checking and build
verification_instructions: Run 'pnpm build' (tsc -b && vite build) and ensure it exits 0 with no type errors
snapshot_or_generated_files: convex/_generated/ contains pre-generated API types (api.d.ts, dataModel.d.ts, server.d.ts). These are generated by 'npx convex dev' but pre-exist in the repo. Do not delete them.
environment_constraints: Convex CLI cannot connect to cloud in sandbox (no CONVEX_URL). Build and type-check work locally. Network allows npm package installation.
contribution_requirements: Korean UI text. Follow existing code patterns. Tailwind CSS v4 utility classes. Mobile-first design (max-w-[480px] layout). Use lucide-react for icons. Use existing ui.tsx components.
key_patterns: Session auth via localStorage token + convex/auth.ts helpers (memberFromToken, requireMember, requireAdmin). Pages in src/pages/, shared components in src/components/. Backend functions in convex/ with validators. Public member data uses toPublicMember projection (no phone). Card/Badge/Button/Input/Field/Chip/SegmentedControl from components/ui.tsx. Format helpers in lib/format.ts. cn() utility for class merging.
directory_structure: Root: Vite config, tsconfig, capacitor config. src/: App.tsx (routes), pages/ (page components), components/ (shared + admin/), lib/ (utils). convex/: schema.ts, backend functions (auth, members, requests, matches, connections, contributions, events, notifications, admin, util, seed, push, audit), _generated/. public/: static assets.
